title: openalex_W4414088906
universal_lens: A foundational data access framework for college football analytics integrating API endpoints, metadata, and probabilistic performance metrics. A unified framework for college football data integration using structured tibbles and probabilistic play-state transitions across temporal and spatial dimensions.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian inference engine mapping CFBD API data streams to win probability and expected points added (EPA) using conformal prediction for uncertainty quantification. Bayesian inference over CFBD play data to estimate team performance likelihood under varying game states, leveraging timeout and field position as stochastic variables.
gse_mapping: Situational reasoning engine modeling game states through temporal transitions of play-by-play data, leveraging PPA and betting line dynamics for strategic decision trees. Situational reasoning engine models team dynamics through state transitions defined by play types, timeouts, and field position, enabling predictive action selection.
